_about: Stage 66 - the HSN/SAC master list the New Item HSN picker suggests from (engines/hsn_suggest.go). Rates are the GST rates in force from 22 Sep 2025 (GST 2.0, 56th GST Council). A code with no rate is suggested without one - the user types it. Suggestions only: a client's own HSN Code list and its own items always outrank this file, and nothing here is ever enforced. keywords score 3 (they decide WHICH code: the material or the exact product), related score 1 (they say what KIND of thing it is), exclude drops the code. Words are matched whole, singular or plural, after spelling is folded (aluminum = aluminium, jewelry = jewellery). @name expands a word_lists entry.
